title: The Great Fire jaunt shows what each stop tells
items: Stop 3 now stands at Jackson and Franklin, by the Parmelee stable, as the story says.
Landmarks catch at the hour their stop names: the O'Leary barn is alight, and Field, Leiter & Co. burns at eight in the morning.
Washington Square holds the furniture people carried there, burning in the night and charred on scorched grass by noon.
Goods heaped among the old cemetery graves catch as the fire reaches Lincoln Park.
The empty button under the stop card is gone.
